Leah (Marketing Ops): Quick sync 10m1 1June Summit is green. Need final reg page, Zoom recording + SRT pipeline, HubSpot routing, and replay gating by Mon COB.
Ben (Growth): Two CTAs: primary 'Register  Free' and secondary 'Request a demo' (show when company_size == 500+). Mobile shows primary only.
Priya (Design): Hero + mobile variants posted to Figma. Will keep form to 6 fields.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Form fields: first_name, last_name, email, company, company_size (<50 / 50-500 / 500+), role, gdpr_consent (required). Hidden field source_detail = "jun_summit_2026". Add ICS + Google Calendar buttons.
Omar (Events): Zoom plan: cloud recording + audio transcript ON, enable "Optimize for 3rd party captions" to get SRT. SRT ingest: srt://ingest.redwood.example:9044/summit423. Local host record as fallback.
ZoomBot: Meeting created https://zoom.us/j/3334445555 (ID: 333-444-5555). SRT test scheduled Jun 18 09:00 PT.
Ben (Growth): HubSpot mapping: lead_source, event_name, company_size_segment, source_detail, ab_variant. Routing: if company_size == '500+' -> ae-inbound, else -> sdr-inbound. Tag utm_campaign=jun_summit_2026.
Zoe (Sales): For 500+ leads, include AE starter note: 'interested in production inference latency/cost'. Also alert AE Slack channel when attended_live == true.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Replay policy: public open replay for 14 days, then gated at day 15 (email to unlock). Clips remain public. We push recordings to S3 and set retention: public folder 14d -> gated folder.
Omar (Events): I'll own clip extraction & timecodes during event. Ben will own clip titles and distribution. Priya will deliver thumbnails (3 crops).
Ben (Growth): Post-event cadence: 0-24h send replay + CTA to book demo; Day 7 highlights; Day 15 gated full download. Mark attended_live true if joined >5 minutes via Zoom webhook.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Dev note: include hidden numeric company_employee_count, validate integer. Add simple captcha to prevent bots. Persist gdpr_consent boolean to HS property 'gdpr_consent'.
Omar (Events): Infra confirmed for port 9044 from Zoom IP ranges. I'll run SRT smoke test Jun 18 and full dress rehearsal Jun 19 10:00 PT.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Ownership recap: Leah=reg page + HS fields; Priya=design + thumbs; Omar=Zoom + SRT + clips + S3; Ben=emails + HS routing; Zoe=AE brief. React with :thumbsup: when your Asana tasks are done.
